technical-summary: Diagnosed and fixed three gpt-auto defects using a new continuous DOM monitor (tests/gpt_auto/_debug_dom_monitor.py) that samples the live tab and records WHICH element satisfies each is_generating() sub-check, rather than only the aggregate boolean. (1) Root cause of multi-minute/indefinite turn hangs: ChatGPT aborts an in-flight SSE response after its first chunk once the tab is occluded -- captured live as an assistant block frozen at 10 characters for 15+ minutes with streaming-animation still applied and the stop button already gone; confirmed by probing document.visibilityState=='hidden' with no CDP client holding emulation. Fixed with a new keep_page_active CDP command (Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled + Page.setWebLifecycleState 'active') applied on the session's long-lived client at open and re-asserted per turn (the first turn navigates workspace-root -> /c/{id}, and the new renderer does not inherit emulation). Unlike bringToFront this does not steal user focus. Causally validated: applying it to the frozen 15-minute stream completed that turn within ~60s. (2) is_generating() checked [data-testid="stop-generating"], which does not exist in current ChatGPT DOM -- the real element is data-testid="stop-button" (aria-label "Stop answering"). The check documented as the 'primary and most reliable signal' was dead code; detection was silently surviving on the locale-dependent aria-label substring fallback alone. Now accepts both testids. (3) The broad busy/loader selectors ([class*="loading"] etc., which match e.g. loading-shimmer-tertiary) had no visibility requirement, so any hidden zero-size element with a matching class would pin the predicate true indefinitely; all broad selectors now require actual visibility. Also added detached-execution-context retry to dom_reader's evaluate calls (navigation mid-poll is expected, not a failure), and rewired test_demo_plan_review.py to use the production wait_for_response with a Turn1-vs-Turn2 distinctness assertion.
user-summary-candidate: Browser-driven ChatGPT sessions no longer stall part-way through a long answer when you switch to another window, and correctly detect when a response has finished.

technical-summary: Resolved sequencing and scope for the session/protocol-surface tranche via a two-turn adversarial review with an external reviewer (gpt-auto reading the branch directly), recorded as RV918-RV923. Two plan-correctness defects found and fixed, both verified against the tree rather than accepted on assertion: (1) AS99 and AS100 both delegated caller/delegation authorization to AS101, which was rewritten 2026-08-08 into the compute-resource taxonomy item and owns no authorization model -- both references now resolved directly against the recorded local/internal/non-hostile deployment model, with AS99 clarifying that 'external ACP client' means external to the process/protocol boundary, not untrusted ingress. (2) AS100 step 6 said to 'give the harness' a delegation capability; verified in config/components/agents.yaml that ag-agents-gateway is already propagate: providers exposing agent_task_submit/status/cancel/list_definitions -- local delegation is reachable today but unbounded (no recursion depth, timeout propagation or ownership attribution), so the step is reframed as bounding a live path. Considered and rejected splitting AS100 into a separate AS100A. AS103 dissolved (state: superseded) with its residue distributed to AS93 (metadata-cursor bounds/session mismatch/restart gap), AS94 (unified-cursor mismatch, malformed outer cursor) and AS95 (already owns duplicate-control idempotency); its stale 'foundation integrity helper' files entry, which contradicted its own Detailed Solution, is withdrawn. AS102 given an explicit 'open early, close late' shape after the intermediate 'small AS102-core slice' proposal was withdrawn -- its reachability guard is the architectural heart, not a cheap preparatory slice. AS104's single evidence gate split into two (measurement plumbing gated only on AS85's manifest-identity contract; policy/presets/migration/default-removal still gated on real usage), resolving a circularity where the item was blocked on evidence its own step 1 collects, plus the governing rule that 'not observed' must never mean 'unused'. AS98's vague volatility deferral replaced with a platform-scoped gate: AS90 gates only a Windows deterministic-close claim, not the whole item, which can otherwise run parallel to AS93-95.
